analysis_scope: Prospective report and acceptance specification, frozen before new comparative held-out effects. No runtime or sampling changes.

causal.chosen_answer_report: For every arm/policy/scoring convention report exact n, correct count and accuracy; paired treatment-minus-stock gain/loss/both-correct/both-wrong and changed chosen-answer counts, with item IDs retained.

item_sensitivity_interval.bounds: Nearest-rank empirical2.5th and97.5th percentiles: sorted replicate indices ceil(p*10000)-1
item_sensitivity_interval.label: 95% conditional paired-item sensitivity interval
item_sensitivity_interval.limitations: One launch per arm; not launch/host/RNG variance, equivalence or evidence of generalization to all10042 items. Unadjusted descriptive intervals across the declared endpoint family.
item_sensitivity_interval.method: Paired nonparametric item bootstrap with common resampled item indices for all reported contrasts
item_sensitivity_interval.rng: Python random.Random(0), sampling n=256 indices with replacement per replicate in fixed selected-item order

causal.policy_caveat: Serial full-reprefill causal scoring under an arm is distinct from incremental KV reuse and mixed PAR-prefill/native-decode generation.
required_wire_checks: Exact prefix input tokens[:j]; target token tokens[j] absent from prompt at its scored position; no target forcing, logit bias or allowed-token constraint.
The arbitrary target ID appears only in logprob selection; response LP is for that exact ID, not substituted sampled-token LP.
One request completes before the next is submitted globally; no concurrent later prefix/teacher/future request; retain transport and raw body hashes.
Full re-prefill per scored position, native prefix caching disabled; same frozen source/model, four physical ranks and48 actual router objects per rank.
All six training analyses and native contracts close before selected heldout protocol freeze; all three heldout raw analyses close before contrasts.
causal.score_effect_report: For both teacher/prefix and raw/character-normalized score, report treatment-minus-stock and teacher-minus-prefix score shifts. Average the four candidate score changes within each item, then average across256 paired items; units nats (raw) or nats per normalization character. Retain exact candidate scores and predictions.
causal.teacher_prefix_diagnostics: For every arm including stock and both scoring conventions, report teacher-minus-prefix accuracy and chosen-answer flips plus training future/order/cohort diagnostics. The difference includes future-conditioned input, cohort packing and numerical execution; no attribution solely to future leakage.

handoff_checks: Same fresh8H200 allocation, native stock-prefill/native-decode actual NIXL baseline, treatment PAR-prefill/native-decode; no monolithic baseline substitution.
Separate fresh native proofs bind full internal request IDs, positive external allocation, completed native receive, exact native routing and final prompt-row recomputation.
Clean timed server identity/source/command and raw two-leg JSON/SSE replay; no probe/profiler or routing/RPC ledger inside timed interval.
Every timed cohort requires off-clock per-engine native NIXL counts/bytes matching256 total transfers and25,769,803,776 bytes (each64 and6,442,450,944) plus zero failures.
Source-correct native/API cached_tokens exact0 denotes producer prefix-cache hits, not transferred KV coverage.
All response IDs/transfer parameters/output token IDs/usage, wave ordering and cohort/individual recorded clock formulas rechecked; no summed-kernel inference.
hybrid.hardware_inference: One fresh eight-H200 host with three paired timing sweeps. Do not pool H100 initial prefill, author repeats, previous partial H200 timing, public monolithic quality, or causal full-reprefill Hella.
hybrid.numerics: Retain monolithic/handoff training differences diagnostically; KV checksum observations do not prove numerical equivalence or absence of timing-dependent visibility effects.
hybrid.performance_report: Reuse frozen paired_hybrid_statistics_v1.py and protocol, SHA-pinned: per-launch arithmetic mean of all3 measured cohort wall times, paired treatment/stock log ratios across3 independent fresh-launch sweeps; geometric mean effect and Student t df2 intervals; throughput is inverse wall-time ratio. Retain all3 ratios and all rounds.
hybrid.quality_report: For all1319 paired items report flexible and strict stock/treatment correct counts, gains/losses and observed percentage-point differences. One fresh server pair per arm; no new confidence interval, numerical equivalence or noninferiority claim.

quality_workload.capped_or_parse_failure_items: Retain in denominator; exact flexible and strict frozen scorer.

publication_rules: Report all declared arms and endpoints, including null/negative results.
Do not claim full10042 Hella evaluation or equivalent quality.
Keep elapsed wall-time, throughput, task accuracy and candidate scoring deltas explicitly labeled.
A completed raw audit certifies captured evidence within its stated limits; it is not tensor-level proof for every clean timed request.

shared_acceptance.archival: Every report cites actual fresh plan/raw-audit/whole-archive/source/runtime hashes; no archived predecessor PID looked up in current namespace.
shared_acceptance.cleanup: Exact fresh controller/server PID+start ticks/owned groups close; all required source/native hashes unchanged; failed attempts retained.
shared_acceptance.performance_quality_gate: Comparative hybrid effects require all three instrumented proofs, all nine clean timed launches and all three full quality launches closed and raw-audited. No quality threshold or output equality filter.
shared_acceptance.raw_policy: Complete exact frozen request/response/SSE inventory and immutable source/plan/owner/cleanup chain; recompute metrics from archived raw rather than trust stored aggregates. Any missing or invalid required cell makes that campaign effects null.
